company.shortDescription: Vectra AI develops an AI-driven integrated attack signal for threat detection and response.
company.description: Vectra AI develops an AI-driven integrated attack signal for threat detection and response. It empowers hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises to see and stop advanced attacks before they become breaches. The company assists SOC analysts in turning the tables on attackers by applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to the problem of finding attack signals.

The solution combines Vectra AI's network detection and response with CrowdStrike's endpoint protection, aiming to provide real-time detection and response across hybrid environments. The offering is designed for rapid deployment, transparent pricing, and ease of adoption, addressing the needs of smaller security teams and managed security service providers.

aiResearchSummary.text: Vectra AI is researching methods for managing security alerts by automatically isolating malicious activity using ensemble pattern recognition, as described in 'Method, product, and system for automatically isolating malicious security.' Their work also includes analyzing computer networks to identify attack paths and generate detection signatures, as detailed in titles such as 'Method, product, and system for analyzing a computer network to identify attack' and 'Method, product, and system for generating detection signatures.' These areas focus on AI-driven threat detection and response.
